public.title: Drizzle Query Builder II
public.description: input {rows,where?,orderBy?,offset?,limit?,select}; filter/order/page as an in-memory query plan, where fields are exact primitive equality constraints, orderBy one {key,direction}. Select maps output aliases to source field names, which must exist. Return objects containing only selected aliases, preserving filtered/sorted row order; empty select emits {} per row. At most 40 rows and 8 selected fields. Aliases are distinct safe keys. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, fixtures and reference solutions, 2026. Covers a common JavaScript practice topic; no third-party exercise text or implementation copied.

explanation: Execute the row pipeline then construct each projection from alias/source pairs. O(filter/sort work plus rows times selected fields) time and output space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
